recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 免疫染色中，只有少數散在的單顆陽性細胞與血管內皮著色，沒有陽性母細胞成群或成片；表示母細胞未增加（<5%），符合 MDS-RS 而非高風險 MDS 或急性白血病。
features: Hypercellular marrow with numerous negative hematopoietic cells between fat spaces
Only rare scattered single CD34-positive mononuclear cells
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Positive internal control staining of endothelial cells lining small vessels/sinusoids
Faint granular staining in a megakaryocyte-like cell
describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow with only rare scattered single CD34-positive cells, estimated at well below 5% of cellularity in this field. There are no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts. Endothelial cells of small vessels are positive, serving as an internal control. The findings indicate no increase in blasts, supporting a lower-risk myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB shows increased CD34+ blasts (5-19% in marrow), often in clusters or abnormal localization, unlike the rare single cells here.
AML shows sheets of CD34+ blasts (≥20%), not seen in this field.
CD34 alone cannot separate them; dysplasia, ring sideroblasts, and cytogenetic/SF3B1 findings are required.
